defect_interactions.interaction_type: dislocation accumulation / local misorientation hot-spots adjacent to martensite plates
defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: KAM hot-spots near M at 335 °C; mean KAM ~0.825° at 335 °C (median 0.692°); bands of elevated misorientation along lath/packet boundaries and at sheaf tips

interfaces.interface_notes: S5 shows a clean interface network: film-like γr at bainite lath boundaries; because films are near/below the EBSD step size, EBSD under-counts γr relative to XRD, so XRD is taken as quantitative for phase fractions.
interfaces.phase_evolution: Lowering TB from 365 °C to 335 °C refines the bainitic plates, concentrates local lattice curvature near martensite and lath interfaces, and reduces/stiffens γr; sporadic lenticular martensite forms at 335 °C (Ms 331 °C + 4 K) via stress-assisted transformation and local heterogeneities.

processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: promotes uniform composition and microstructure throughout the steel blocks
Hot rolling reduced thickness to ~11 mm followed by slow cooling in the oven; samples then fabricated by water jet cutting (OMAX 2626).

TA = 1150 °C is an optimized austenitizing temperature for S5 (carbide dissolution advanced, αp suppressed to a very small residual fraction ≲1 %). MatCalc ferrite-free TA for S5 = 986 °C; measured operational TA ~900 °C.

processing_steps.method: controlled cooling from austenitization to austempering temperature
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: 100 K/s is sufficiently fast to suppress intermediate phase transformations and ensure fine bainitic transformation.
TB = 335 °C is ~4 °C above the measured Ms (331 °C) for S5; incubation period completed within 10 s; TB 335 °C is the lowest of the two S5 austempering temperatures.

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Specimen austenitized at TA = 1150 °C and austempered at TB = 335 °C (T_A/T_B condition for this sample); tensile test at room temperature (not explicitly stated)
measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: ASTM E8 sub-size round specimens (12.5 mm gauge length, 2.5 mm diameter, 7 mm shoulder length)

defects.type: local misorientation / geometrically necessary dislocations (KAM hot-spots)

grain_structure.texture: narrow bainitic-ferrite lath packets with intra-packet orientation clustering; high-angle packet/block boundaries

phases_present.morphology: fine parallel bainitic lamellae in narrow packets with intra-packet orientation clustering separated by high-angle packet/block boundaries
sporadic lenticular plates; fine bainitic lamellae wrapped inside larger martensite units
trace polygonal ferrite (αp on grain boundaries seen in SEM)

structures.overall_structure: Predominantly bainitic microstructure produced by austempering S5 at 335 °C; fine, well-connected bainitic ferrite network with minimal impingement, film-like retained austenite at bainite lath boundaries, only sparse lenticular martensite (below XRD detectability) and a trace (<1 %) of polygonal ferrite; no SEM-resolvable (Fe,M)xCy after austempering.
